metadataRaw.title: The BEST Neck Self Mobilization Stretch
metadataRaw.description:
In this video, Dr. Rowe shows the BEST way to self mobilize your neck with a simple stretch.

Although rotational movements are not the most ideal for self mobilization of the neck, if you choose to do it anyway -- this particular method is one of the best ways to release tight neck muscles and joints.

As a BONUS: you might just get a self crack, pop, or release in the neck.

It's simple, EASY, and only requires a small towel. 

If you're looking for a QUICK release of tension in the neck to get a nice CRACK or POP, this video may help. It may also help give more overall movement in the neck, less achy pain, and overall stiffness.

Watch now and learn the best neck self mobilization stretch
